title: Campaign: ReadyNeuro, patterns along time within one run
abstract: Subcampaign of 'what new facts about human brain activity can ReadyNeuro reveal?'. Scope: Patterns that vary with time inside a single run, with no external labels. How it splits: Is the pattern's timescale under 20 s (one hemodynamic response and faster) or 20 s and longer (state changes, drift)? It holds 3 leaf studies with first tests (rare-transients, physio-from-bold, time-in-scan). No results yet.
